title: Zesty Crispy Peruvian Chicken Pollo A La Brasa
description: A classic Peruvian dish featuring crispy chicken marinated in a zesty mixture of spices and herbs, perfect for a date night dinner
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lime juice, Dijon mustard, garlic, salt, black pepper, and paprika
Add the chicken legs to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade
Let the chicken marinate for at least 30 minutes
Remove the chicken from the marinade and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper
Bake the chicken in the preheated oven for 30 minutes
While the chicken is baking, heat a skillet over medium-high heat
Add the chopped basil leaves to the skillet and saute for 1 minute
After the chicken has baked for 30 minutes, increase the oven temperature to broil and cook for an additional 5 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown
Serve the chicken hot, garnished with the sauteed basil leaves
